Membership details.

Winter Club Membership+
  • Membership covers the full Winter term — starts when City of Winnipeg public courses CLOSE, ends when they OPEN.
  • 10% peak discount applies only toward the club member's payment for golf simulator rental.
  • $30/hr off-peak rate applies only toward the club member's payment for golf simulator rental.
  • Off-peak hours: weekdays BEFORE 4PM (excluding holidays), and Sundays AFTER 4PM (excluding pre-holiday Sundays). Manitoba stat holidays apply.
  • Discounts CAN be applied to league play (toward member's simulator rental only).
  • Discounts CANNOT be applied to coaching, clinics, special events, or group bookings spanning more than 1 bay, unless otherwise stated.
  • Members may book standard tee times online 8 days in advance — 1 day ahead of non-members.
  • Members receive 1 day's advance notice for public event registration (e.g. scrambles).
  • Included AVID GOLF hat ($40 value) is subject to select styles and procurement timelines.
  • Limited Time Offers may be promoted to members periodically (extended off-peak hours, product discounts, etc.).
  • Benefits may be added from time to time. No refunds.
Winter Club Fellowship+
  • 1 hour/day of included bay time applies only on non-holiday weekdays BEFORE 4PM.
  • Included bay time applies to the entire bay and everyone in it, to a maximum of 4 guests.
  • All benefits, discounts, off-peak rates, terms & conditions from the Winter Club Membership also apply to Club Fellowship. Please refer to Membership T&Cs above.
  • Benefits may be added from time to time. No refunds.
Summer Membership+
  • Summer Memberships start May 1st and run until October 31st.
  • Members are expected to reserve tee times online. Walk-ins are discouraged in Summer as operating hours may vary based on demand.
  • Membership pricing does not apply to coaching, clinics, special events, or corporate events, and may not be combined with other offers.
  • AVID GOLF intends to close for up to 2 weeks in July and/or August. Active monthly memberships pause for this duration. Full Summer memberships already account for this in their pricing.
  • Summer hours are reduced and subject to change based on member feedback. Contact info@avidgolf.club for requests.
  • No refunds, proration, or additional discounts permitted.

Summer hours.

Summer memberships begin May 1, and summer operating hours begin May 11. Monday & Friday: 4:30–10 pm. Tuesday–Thursday: 9 am–2 pm and 4:30–10 pm. Sunday is closed. Hours may vary with demand and inclement weather.

Planning a Saturday morning visit? Opening times may vary. Check the booking calendar or call to confirm before you arrive.
